:new: New project intention · #39 slopes of compact Hecke operators

My PhD thesis works on creating the infrastructure to formalise results about "slopes of compact Hecke operators", with an initial goal of formalising the results in Daniel Jacobs' thesis.

The required mathematics can be split into a few main areas:

  • Restricted power series (Tate algebras)
  • Newton polygons
  • Non-archimedean Fredholm theory (compact operators)
  • Overconvergent automorphic forms

Future goals could be building towards eigenvarieties and spectral varieties.
